title: Device cleanup threshold is very long

maxDays.text: Days of silence before a device is removed

messages.businessImpact: Records persist long after the hardware has gone, so counts stay inflated and stale devices keep appearing in compliance reporting.
remediation: Reduce the cleanup threshold, commonly to between 60 and 90 days.
messages.cannotSee: Where a tenant keeps several cleanup rules this reads the longest of them, because that is the one deciding how long the oldest record survives, so a tenant with one sensible rule and one careless one is reported on the careless one. What period suits an organisation is a judgement this cannot make: an estate of laptops that travel for months is not the estate the default was written for, which is why the threshold is a parameter.
